enonce.texte:
Certains phrasal verbs sont séparables (on peut mettre l'objet entre le verbe et la particule) et d'autres sont inséparables. Classez les phrasal verbs suivants dans la bonne catégorie.

Phrasal Verbs : look for, give up, turn on, get up, run into, take care of, bring up, give away

questions.texte: Classez ces phrasal verbs en séparables ou inséparables et justifiez.

sousQuestions.texte: Quels sont les phrasal verbs séparables ?
sousQuestions.reponse: turn on (turn the light on), give up (give it up), bring up (bring the topic up), give away (give the money away)

sousQuestions.texte: Quels sont les phrasal verbs inséparables ?
sousQuestions.reponse: look for (look for it), get up (get up), run into (run into someone), take care of (take care of it)

enonce.texte: Pour chaque phrasal verb, écrivez une phrase qui montre que vous comprenez son sens en contexte.

questions.texte: Écrivez une phrase avec chacun des phrasal verbs suivants.

sousQuestions.texte: make up (inventer / se réconcilier)
sousQuestions.reponse: She made up a story to explain her absence. / They made up after their argument.

sousQuestions.texte: come across (tomber sur / donner une impression)
sousQuestions.reponse: I came across an interesting article online. / He comes across as very confident.

sousQuestions.texte: take after (ressembler à)
sousQuestions.reponse: She takes after her mother; they have the same smile.

sousQuestions.texte: carry on (continuer)
sousQuestions.reponse: The teacher told us to carry on with our work.

questions.texte: Écrivez un paragraphe sur votre routine quotidienne avec des phrasal verbs.

intitule: Writing a Professional Email with Phrasal Verbs

enonce.texte:
Rédigez un email professionnel (environ 120 mots) dans lequel vous utilisez les phrasal verbs suivants : follow up, put forward, look into, carry out, follow through, set up

Contexte : Vous écrivez à votre responsable pour proposer un nouveau projet.

questions.texte: Rédigez un email professionnel en utilisant les phrasal verbs donnés.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse :
Subject: Proposal for New Project

Dear Mr. Smith,

I am writing to follow up on our previous discussion about the new sustainability project. I would like to put forward a proposal that could benefit our company. We need to look into the environmental impact of our operations. I suggest we carry out a study to assess the current situation. It is important to follow through on our commitments to environmental responsibility. We could set up a team dedicated to this project. I am confident that this initiative will be successful.

Best regards,
Jean

sousQuestions.texte: I am looking ______ to the holidays. (forward to)
